Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 3, Verse 31

“Those who constantly follow this teaching of mine with faith and without cavilling are also freed from actions.”

A concession for those who cannot yet see it for themselves. Practising in trust is offered as a genuine route, not as a lesser consolation prize.
